verdict.rationale: The only route to obtaining your own records is the Torch FOIA/Privacy Act API, which lets you create a request for Alien File material and track its status (uscis-docs-2, uscis-docs-3, uscis-supp-2). This is a slow, request-based records release, not a self-service export, and nothing indicates the output format or covers myUSCIS account data. missing for 10: self-service bulk export of account and case data, documented open/machine-readable export formats, coverage of all account data beyond A-file material, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
